summary: Connect named bones to axial and appendicular groupings.
objective: Build a skeletal explorer where selecting a group highlights its bones without losing left/right identity.
example_prompts: Build a skeletal explorer where selecting a group highlights its bones without losing left/right identity.

entities.name: Skeleton
entities.guidance: Use distinct skull, vertebral chain, thoracic cage and limb silhouettes; avoid identical cylinders for all bones at close range.

entities.name: Group tree
entities.guidance: Keep anatomical membership separate from render parenting; bilateral bones have stable side-aware IDs.

entities.name: Bone material
entities.guidance: Use a low-gloss neutral family with selection outline; color is an interface cue, not a pathology map.

state_contract.model: Bone identity, anatomical group and laterality; visual hierarchy is not a biomechanical joint model.
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.
actions: Focus one bone and inspect its parent group.

invariants: Selection changes emphasis without renaming or reparenting anatomy.
Do not infer mechanical articulation from category membership.
motion_guidance: Use a camera focus or group reveal; keep bone rest positions intact.
Any exploded view preserves reference lines to the rest pose.
known_limits: No patient-specific anatomy or skeletal motion validation.
A verified mesh and complete naming inventory are required for a comprehensive atlas.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.
